title: Option Berth settings v1
description: Local workspace preferences; no project code or agent execution. Maximum file size: 64 KiB.

$schema.description: Editor-only metadata; never fetched or executed by the client. Runtime limit: 2048 UTF-8 bytes, no control/format characters.

reduceMotion.description: User true OR read-only system reduction; false cannot disable the OS preference.

shellIntegration.description: Only new supported zsh sessions; never restarts running PTYs.

defaultAgent.description: Default for new worktree UI state; existing drafts and selections are unchanged.
